title: From whole-exome sequencing to functional insight: Characterization of rare germline variants in lung cancer.
snippet: Whole-exome sequencing (WES) has greatly expanded the identification of rare germline variants in hereditary cancer predisposition. title: Translational Challenges and Strategies for Antibody Therapeutics in Glioblastoma.
snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) remains difficult to control. Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) have transformed the treatment of several extracranial cancers, but they have not consistently improved survival in GBM.
